title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing grant and scope validation to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The issue arises because OAuthlib does not require the authenticated client's client_id to match the client_id parameter in the request body before validation. This can lead to token authorization bypass, allowing issuance of tokens with unauthorized scopes or grant types.
